title: Clarification regarding closure of Call for Proposal under Research Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme by Technology Development Board (TDB)
body_text:
Certain media report published yesterday (30 th Sept.) claiming shortage of fund as the reason for closure of RDI call by TDB is not correct . TDB has closed its running call purely on “Administrative Reason” as notified on its website. Due to massive influx of project proposals, TDB has decided to take a “PAUSE” & closed its call for the time being which will reopen shortly after assessment of all projects received till 30 th Sept. 2026.  The Investment Committee (IC) & TDB are working overnights to complete the evaluation process expeditiously.
There is absolutely no shortage of fund for disbursement to ETEs.
The DST/ANRF is in the process of assigning several other SLFM also in the very near future.
***
NKR/FT/AA
